title: Tora-x125
tagline: Tora-x125: A secondary market for verified, tokenised impact investments
description: Tora-x125 is a secondary market for verified impact investments. It tokenises green bonds, renewable-energy projects and carbon-removal assets into fractional, tradable digital assets, giving investors liquidity before maturity. Each asset links financial, risk and verified impact data on-chain. Tora-x125 integrates Uniswap v4 for secondary liquidity, 1inch for trading and stablecoin settlement, ENS for project identities, and World ID for investor verification.
how_its_made: Tora-x125 is built around tokenised impact assets and programmable secondary liquidity. We use smart contracts to fractionalise green investments into tradable tokens, with project, financial and impact data linked onchain. Uniswap v4 provides liquidity pools and hooks for dynamic trading logic, while 1inch optimises swap routing and stablecoin settlement. ENS gives projects and issuers readable identities, and World ID supports privacy-preserving investor verification. We also explored a Sui implementation using Move, zkLogin and DeepBook for an alternative high-performance secondary market.
auto_summary: A Next.js and Hardhat project for tokenized impact assets with smart contracts, Uniswap v4 hooks, 1inch Aqua/SwapVM routing, and World ID-gated actions.
